responsibility: This header declares the C entry points that drive gm2 startup: a global frontend initialization routine and a per-compilation initialization-and-compile routine. It is the C/C++ interface companion to init.cc, used by surrounding driver code to trigger module initialization in the correct phase without embedding knowledge of the underlying Modula-2 runtime initializer list.
same_name_distinction: This is the C/C++ declaration side of init, exposing init_FrontEndInit and init_PerCompilationInit as prototypes for native callers. Unlike init.def it is not a Modula-2 definition module, and unlike init.cc it does not perform any initialization sequencing itself.
